title: TRAINING SOCIALLY ALIGNED LANGUAGE MODELS ON SIMULATED SOCIAL INTERACTIONS
benchmark_measurement: The paper did not measure any specific aspect of faith or religion. It focused on general 'social alignment,' 'societal values,' 'morality,' and avoiding harmful or biased content.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion as it was not a focus of the study.
references: Gati Aher, Rosa I. Arriaga, and Adam Tauman Kalai. Using large language models to simulate multiple humans and replicate human subject studies, 2023.
